{"notes": "Visit 1 (left at 2:45). Picture: the whole fish is dark, so it's connected to the start. Both body arcs, the tail junction (~x23) and both tail fins (upper to ~27,6.5; lower to ~27,13.5) are connected. I can't tell who placed which domino, so I'm not crediting anyone for specific pieces beyond what they told me.

Maya: Said at 2:15 the bottom line was down and reached the tail junction. The picture backs that up. She offered to check things on request and said she'd stay out of Tom and Leo's way, which is considerate, but she was somewhat passive. Reliable, with no sign of problems. Execution and collaboration look solid.

Priya: Top line was ~8 dominoes short at 2:00 and reached the tail by 2:30, so her estimate was accurate and she was on pace. Her top arc is connected. She planned to inspect the tail junction and said it looked connected, and the picture agrees. Good ownership, clear updates, and she plans to verify. Her 'looks connected' was a visual check, so I should see whether she tests more rigorously.

Leo: Gave the clearest overview at 1:45: the layout, who's on what, and the lower tail fin queued to lay when the body line arrived. The fins are now connected, but I don't know whether he laid them. Strong coordination and leadership signals so far. He talks about checking the junction, so watch whether he actually does it.

Tom: Silent on this visit and never gave a status. Maya referred to 'Tom and Leo's way', so he's presumably on the tail fins or junction, but I have no direct evidence of his work. I can't rate him yet. Ask him directly next visit what he's contributed.

Next visit: check the tail junction for fragility, since everyone assumes it's fine, and see who's actually verifying versus just talking."}
